executive_summary: Especificación corregida para incluir rangos por leg, ejecuciones reales independientes para k=5/k=10 y resultados de medición locales ignorados por Git.
risks: The canonical DocuTests2 path and edit authority remain unresolved for future external-corpus writes.
The proposal intentionally sets no ranking-quality or performance threshold; gate success proves instrumentation validity only.

key_learnings: Answer hits accept any independently sufficient overlapping chunk.
Per-leg ranks preserve unavailable or truncated states instead of fabricating values.
Independent k=5 and k=10 production runs can share a population but cannot be derived from one another.
The Spanish 22-case ejemplos baseline remains distinct from the new 60-query corpus.
